notes: Critic fix: I took the S1 Skyport station at (530,0) off the list. The plan has no walkable public space there. The quay ends at x 385 (pier 330–385, y ±25), and everything from x 330 to 740 is water. No road or foot path can serve as its `fronts`. I will not hand over an entrance the cell cannot reach.
No legal Skyport position exists on this plan. A station on the pier (x ≤ 385) needs Harbour at x ≤ 185 for the 200 m S-S2 minimum. Circus at 95 forces Harbour to x ≥ 295.
So S1 now has three stations on-sheet: Gardens −160, Circus 95, Harbour 320. Gaps are 255 and 225 m.

For Datum (blocking): the airport line has no airport station. Please add skyport land inside the loop, joined to the quay by a pier or bridge. Add a forecourt or foot path on S1's straight trunk at x 520–560, or extend the trunk. I will then place Skyport there (length 50, `fronts` = the new path id) and rerun N-P2 and W-1.
For Aster: the missing Skyport station is a design gap to raise with Sky, because the plan concept says S1 is the airport line.
Harbour station at (320,0) stands over the quay strip (x 312–330), which is walkable. Its platform runs from x 295 to 345, and its entrance opens onto Harbour Road. That is 12 m from T2 Parade Quay.

All other stops are unchanged. These are hand figures, not checker results: I have no shell. Reach is tightest at crown-terraces and crescent-north (about 247 m each). No plots lie over water, so dropping Skyport does not change N-R1. The next owner should run `bun tools/plan/cli.ts` and send me the output.

Still open: Splice/Keel need to confirm the T1/T2 flat crossing at Market × Boulevard. Waymark needs to decide on seal points at the precinct gates; I placed no T2 stop there. Aster should update the concept note's 'one interchange'.
